• Pack out all trash. There are no trash cans beyond this point.

prompt: A visitor with a dog on May 20 may walk:

options.B: on all trails except the upper loop
options.C: only on the upper loop
options.D: nowhere, because dogs are banned in summer

explanation: Cães na coleira são permitidos, mas o upper loop fica fechado para cães de 1º de abril a 15 de julho, e 20 de maio cai nesse período. Por isso, o visitante pode usar todas as trilhas exceto o upper loop. (A) ignora a restrição; (C) inverte a regra; (D) exagera, porque os cães não são proibidos em toda parte, só no upper loop.

stimulus.title: Exercício B3: e-mail formal (meta de 3 min)
stimulus.content:
TEXT: Email from a course coordinator

Subject: Re: Request to submit Assignment 2 late

Dear Bruna,

Thank you for letting me know about your situation in advance rather than after the deadline. I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell.

Our department policy does not allow me to grant an extension without a doctor's note. If you're able to provide one, I can extend your deadline to next Monday. If not, I can still accept the assignment up to 48 hours late, though the standard 10% late penalty would apply in that case.

Please let me know which option you'd prefer by Thursday so I can update the system.

Best regards,
Dr. Okafor

prompt: What is the main purpose of this email?

options.A: To refuse Bruna's request
options.B: To explain the options available and ask Bruna to choose
options.C: To inform Bruna that her assignment is now overdue
options.D: To apologize for a mistake the department made

explanation: O e-mail lista duas opções (com ou sem atestado) e pede que Bruna escolha até quinta. (A) não recusa, oferece alternativas; (C) o trabalho ainda não está atrasado; (D) não houve erro do departamento.

TEXT: Shuttle timetable notice

CAMPUS ↔ STATION SHUTTLE

Departs Campus Gate: on the hour and at half past, 7:00–19:00, Mon–Fri. Departs Station: at quarter past and quarter to, same times. Journey time: approximately 20 minutes.

The half-past and quarter-to services do not run after 17:00: the last half-past departure from Campus Gate is at 16:30. On weekends and holidays, shuttles leave both stops on the hour only.

options.A: no 17:30 service — after 17:00 the shuttle leaves on the hour only
options.B: a 17:30 service that arrives at the station around 17:50
options.C: a shuttle only if it is a holiday
options.D: a 17:30 service that takes about 45 minutes

explanation: A nota de rodapé é clara: "the last half-past departure from Campus Gate is at 16:30", e depois das 17:00 o serviço é "on the hour only". Logo, não existe saída às 17:30 na terça-feira. Este item treina a leitura da nota de rodapé, e quem marca (B) leu só a linha principal e deixou passar a exceção.

stimulus.title: Exercício B5: post de rede social (meta de 3 min)
stimulus.content:
TEXT: A social media post from a local bakery

🥐 Riverside Bakery · Posted 2 hours ago

Big news, everyone! Starting next Tuesday, we're extending our weekday hours — open at 6:30 AM instead of 7:00 AM, so early risers can grab their coffee and croissants before work. 🌅

Come say hi and let us know what you think of the new hours!

Weekend hours are unchanged (8 AM–3 PM, same as always).

options.D: To advertise a new type of bread

explanation: O post inteiro gira em torno de um anúncio: abrir mais cedo nos dias de semana. (A) inverte; (C) não pede desculpas; (D) nenhum pão novo.

stimulus.content:
TEXT: Email from the University Housing Office

Subject: Winter Break Residence Hall Closing

Dear Residents,

All campus residence halls will close for winter break on Friday, December 20, at 6:00 p.m. and reopen on Saturday, January 11, at 9:00 a.m.

International students and varsity athletes who need to remain on campus during the break may apply for temporary housing in Maple Court. This accommodation is free of charge if you submit the online form by December 6. Applications received after December 6 will still be accepted until December 13, but a $35 late processing fee will apply.

Before leaving on December 20, all residents — including those moving temporarily to Maple Court — must unplug mini-fridges and lamps in their regular rooms.

Sincerely,
Office of Residential Life

explanation: A inscrição até 6 de dezembro é gratuita, mas pedidos enviados entre 6 e 13 de dezembro pagam taxa de processamento de $35 (a $35 late processing fee will apply), o que torna (C) correta. A opção (A) ignora que o formulário ainda é aceito até o dia 13.

stimulus.content:
TEXT: Guidelines at the Engineering Makerspace

3D PRINTING QUEUE — UNDERGRADUATE GUIDELINES

1. Safety Orientation: Before submitting your first print job, you must pass the 20-minute online safety quiz on the student portal with a score of 100%.

2. Scheduling: Upload your file to the lab queue. Print jobs estimated at under 3 hours run during daytime hours (9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.). Any job requiring 3 hours or more is automatically scheduled for the overnight batch and will be ready the next morning.

3. Cost and Pickup: Filament is billed at $0.08 per gram. Each student receives a $10.00 credit per semester for required coursework; personal projects do not qualify for this credit. Completed prints not picked up within 5 business days are recycled.

options.C: After 5 business days, once shorter jobs are finished
options.D: Overnight, becoming available the following morning

explanation: A regra 2 estabelece que qualquer impressão de 3 horas ou mais entra no lote noturno para entrega na manhã seguinte (automatically scheduled for the overnight batch and will be ready the next morning), validando (D). A opção (A) aplica a regra de projetos com menos de 3 horas.

Subject: Conditional Approval — Summer Fieldwork Grant (#UG-409)

Dear Lucas,

The committee was impressed by your proposal to survey native pollinators in urban community gardens and is pleased to offer conditional funding of $2,400. Before the funds can be disbursed, however, two revisions are required.

Sincerely,
Prof. Elena Vance, Committee Chair

IMMUNIZATION COMPLIANCE AND SPRING REGISTRATION HOLDS

While incoming first-year undergraduates must submit complete immunization records prior to dorm move-in, transfer and graduate students are granted a 30-day grace period from the first day of fall classes to upload missing documentation. stimulus.title: Exercício B15: aviso de biblioteca (meta de 4 min)
stimulus.content:
TEXT: Policy notice from the University Archives and Special Collections

RESEARCHER ACCESS AND REPRODUCTION GUIDELINES

Unlike the main library's general holdings, materials housed in Special Collections are non-circulating and may be consulted only in the Reading Room by appointment. Requests for archival boxes should be submitted through the online catalog at least two business days prior to your visit, as nearly half of our holdings are kept in a climate-controlled off-site facility from which deliveries arrive only on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

Researchers are welcome to take reference photographs using handheld devices with the flash turned off. However, high-resolution digital scans intended for publication or public display require a formal reproduction request and written permission from the copyright holder, unless the work has entered the public domain. To protect fragile manuscripts, fountain pens, highlighters, and coats are prohibited at the reading tables; lockers and pencils are supplied in the entry hall.

prompt: Why does the archive ask researchers to request materials at least two business days in advance?

options.A: Many items are stored off campus and are transported only twice a week
options.B: Archivists must inspect every manuscript for damage before each appointment
options.C: The Reading Room has seating for only a small number of visitors each day
options.D: Copyright permission must be verified before any archival box is opened

explanation: O primeiro parágrafo explica o motivo da antecedência com o conector as: quase metade do acervo fica em uma instalação externa e as entregas ocorrem apenas às terças e quintas (deliveries arrive only on Tuesday and Thursday mornings), confirmando (A). A opção (D) mistura a regra de publicação do segundo parágrafo com a consulta local.
